Leah Green: Hey team — quick ask. Can we run a focused SI co-sell pipeline sweep for accounts that touch the cloud marketplace and hardware partners before Q2 planning? Looking to: 1) reconcile account mapping, 2) nudge stale opportunities, 3) confirm rules of engagement for claims. Thinking a lightweight sweep this week. Thoughts?

Samir Patel: I can own marketplace-linked accounts. Will pull Marketplace CRM list + last-touch timestamp. Do we want to include trial credits used as a signal for priority? :thinking_face:

Diego Cruz: I can take hardware partners (EdgeBox, RackWave). Quick note on mapping: for any account with active PO or >$50k TCV, the field (AE) keeps primary claim unless SI has an explicit co-sell contact. Otherwise SI can be assigned as the active owner for motion outreach. I’ll update the mapping sheet with these rules.

Maya Chen: Recommend this cadence: sweep Thurs (pull lists) -> Fri morning shortlist -> Fri afternoon nudge send. Outreach owner = Maya (template below) and follow-ups go to the SI owner after 3 business days if contact engages. Template (please keep canned but personal):

```
Hi <FirstName>,
Quick note from <SI Partner> + Redwood — we saw activity on your account (marketplace trial / hardware inquiry). Wanted to check if you’d like a short call to review integration and pricing options.
Available slots: [link]
Thanks,
<Name> (on behalf of <SI Partner> & Redwood)
```

Jules: A few rules of engagement we should lock in so sales ops and legal are happy: 1) No unilateral account claims — must document contact and warming activity in CRM; 2) Marketplace-sourced leads default to Redwood first-touch unless SI has signed intake form; 3) Hardware partner referrals get a higher priority tag but still require an intro email from the partner. For edge cases we escalate to Leah.

partner-bot: New sheet created: https://docs.example.com/s/si-pipeline-sweep-1805550123 (access: @partnerships) :robot_face:

Leah Green: Perfect — owners: Samir = marketplace list, Diego = hardware list & mapping updates, Maya = outreach & nudge sends, Jules = RoE & escalation. Goal: shortlist by 2024-05-03 15:00 UTC and first nudge sent by 2024-05-03 18:00 UTC. Please react with :white_check_mark: when you have visibility or post blockers.

Samir Patel: :white_check_mark: I’ll have the list by Thu EOD PST.

Diego Cruz: :rocket: mapping update in the sheet in 60m.

Maya Chen: :raised_hands: will prep templates and stamping process.

Jules: :eyes: will add RoE doc and exception flow.

Leah Green: Thanks everyone — will sync briefly Fri 16:00 UTC if we need realtime triage.
